rows.heading: Update.
rows.current_text: No later than the third year after the effective date of this section 28-901.1 and every third year thereafter, the commissioner shall submit to the city council proposed amendments that he or she determines should be made to this code to bring it up to date with the latest edition of the International Fuel Gas Code or otherwise modify the provisions thereof. In addition, prior to the submission of such proposal to the city council, such proposal shall be submitted to an advisory committee established by the commissioner pursuant to this title for review and comment.

hierarchy.label: Chapter 9: New York City Fuel Gas Code
Article 901: Enactment and Update of the New York City Fuel Gas Code

rows.heading: Enactment of the New York City Fuel Gas Code.
rows.current_text: The New York city fuel gas code based on the 2009 edition of the International Fuel Gas Code published by the International Code Council, with changes that reflect the unique character of the city and amendments that bring it up to date with the 2015 edition of such International Fuel Gas Code, is hereby adopted to read as follows:
